headline: Over 15,000 children missing in Bangladesh between January and July
summary: A systemic crisis of individualism and the breakdown of community safety nets are leaving children vulnerable to crime and juvenile delinquency.
details: The Police Headquarters reported that 15,717 children went missing between January and July this year. While 13,679 were rescued or returned, the scale of the crisis highlights a growing vulnerability among the youth.
caption:
15,717 children reported missing in just seven months. Why is our community safety net failing?

The Police Headquarters reported that 15,717 children went missing between January and July this year. While 13,679 were rescued or returned, the scale of the crisis highlights a growing vulnerability among the youth.

#Bangladesh #ChildSafety #SocialCrisis #MissingChildren #Community

Source: Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline: Govt employees' minimum salary to be 33,000 taka including allowances
summary: A new pay structure is being introduced for government employees in Bangladesh, raising the lowest pay scale.
details: Under the new pay structure, the minimum salary for government employees will be slightly more than 33,000 taka, including allowances.
caption:
Minimum government salary is set to rise to over 33,000 taka.

Under the new pay structure, the minimum salary for government employees will be slightly more than 33,000 taka, including allowances.
